assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX sprite, one isolated muzzle flash for a small silver revolver in a colorful cute board game. White-hot small core with flowing pale yellow and amber flame tongues, soft luminous falloff, wispy feathered irregular edges and a few tiny bright embers. Hand-painted polished game VFX texture with fluid airbrushed light, subtle internal hot gas texture, not a flat symbol. Compact horizontal silhouette, well padded on every side, all fire fully inside frame. Square canvas, truly transparent RGBA background including around soft glow. NO gun, objects, background, words, numbers, outline, star polygon, symmetric starburst, straight beams, badge, border, frame or checkerboard pattern. Only one firing flash sprite; not a sprite sheet.
